summary: Phase 2 implements six behavioral improvements: URL validation in load_config(), CLI error handling with try/except, replacing all print() calls with logger.info() in the orchestrator, moving Jinja2 Environment to module-level constants, adding trust boundary comments, and wiring the HTML cache into _process_article(). All 19 existing tests pass after the changes.

patternsFollowed.notes: Logger already existed in orchestrator.py and config.py. Module-level _env and _template added to compiler.py following underscore prefix convention for private module state.
ValueError raised for invalid URLs. CLI entry point catches FileNotFoundError, KeyError, and ValueError, prints to stderr, returns exit code 1.

patternsFollowed.patternName: Private helper functions with underscore prefix
patternsFollowed.notes: _print_summary renamed to _log_summary since it no longer prints. Module-level _env and _template use underscore prefix for private state.
URL validation added between TOML loading and Config construction.

implementedFeatures.description: Added validation of pinboard_feed_url in load_config() — raises ValueError if URL is empty or does not start with http:// or https://.
Wrapped load_config() call in __main__.py with try/except catching FileNotFoundError, KeyError, and ValueError. Prints user-friendly message to stderr and returns exit code 1.

implementedFeatures.featureName: Replace print() with logger.info() in orchestrator
implementedFeatures.description: Replaced all five print() calls across three call sites (dry-run output, archive cap message, run summary) with logger.info() using %-style formatting. Renamed _print_summary to _log_summary.
implementedFeatures.notes: _print_summary renamed to _log_summary to reflect the behavioral change.

implementedFeatures.featureName: Update orchestrator tests capsys to caplog
implementedFeatures.description: Updated test_dry_run_prints_list_without_writing and test_since_days_cap_message_when_articles_excluded to use caplog instead of capsys, with caplog.at_level(logging.INFO, logger='courier.orchestrator') context manager.
implementedFeatures.notes: Added 'import logging' to test file imports.

implementedFeatures.description: Moved Environment(...) and get_template(...) from inside compile_document() to module-level _env and _template constants. compile_document() now uses _template.render() directly.
implementedFeatures.patternUsed: Private helper functions with underscore prefix
implementedFeatures.notes: Template is package data, always present; fail-fast at import time.

implementedFeatures.description: Added Python comment in compiler.py above _env explaining why autoescape=True coexists with | safe. Added Jinja2 comment in document.xhtml above the {{ article.content | safe }} line.

Added store.read_cached_html() call before fetcher.fetch_article() to check for cached raw HTML. On cache miss, fetches from network and writes raw HTML to cache via store.write_cached_html(). After successful extraction, writes extracted content to cache.
implementedFeatures.notes: Cache read/write calls are not wrapped in additional try/except, consistent with existing error handling pattern.

implementedFeatures.featureName: Update orchestrator tests for cache wiring
implementedFeatures.description: Added mock_store.read_cached_html.return_value = None to all 10 tests in test_orchestrator.py that mock store, ensuring they continue to test the full fetch-from-network path.
implementedFeatures.patternUsed: Mocking pipeline modules in orchestrator tests
implementedFeatures.notes: Applied defensively to all tests with mock_store, including those that don't reach _process_article().

nextSteps: Phase 2 Testing: Write config validation tests and run full regression suite
Phase 3: Test infrastructure (conftest.py) and new test modules for extractor, compiler, and store
additionalNotes: All 19 existing tests pass after the changes. No bugs encountered during implementation.
